# Chronodynamic Relativity (CR)

> Author: Joshua A. Shreve
> ORCID: [0009-0000-5942-5351](https://orcid.org/0009-0000-5942-5351)
> Zenodo Concept DOI: [10.5281/zenodo.22697449](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22697449)
> Repository: [https://github.com/joshreve/Chronodynamic-Relativity](https://github.com/joshreve/Chronodynamic-Relativity)
> License: MIT

Chronodynamic Relativity is a first-principles theoretical framework formulated by Joshua A. Shreve. It resolves the core cosmological and astrophysical anomalies (cosmic acceleration, galactic flat rotation curves, CMB acoustic peak driving, and cluster merger gas-potential decoupling) without cold dark matter particles (\Omega_{cdm} = 0) or arbitrary cosmological constants (\Lambda = 0).

## Core Principles
- **Relativistic Space Density Dynamics:** Cosmic space possesses a variable dynamic density \rho_s(t) = \rho_0 (t_0/t) whose non-equilibrium gradient tension sources metric expansion and geometric inertia.
- **Relativistic Conformal Metric Clock Scaling:** Metric clock rates scale continuously as \eta(z) = (1+z)^n, where n = 1.0, naturally yielding linear cosmic expansion H(t) = 1/t and resolving the Hubble tension.
- **Non-Linear Algebraic Root Gravity:** Eliminates the dark matter halo hypothesis via exact algebraic root gravity g_{eff} = 0.5 * [g_N + \sqrt{g_N^2 + 4 g_N a_c(t)}], where critical acceleration a_c(t) = c / (4\pi t) is expansion-derived.
- **Shear-Thickening Causal Metric Latency:** High-velocity cluster mergers (e.g. Bullet Cluster 1E 0657-56, El Gordo ACT-CL J0102-4915) induce dynamic viscous latency \tau_{eff} in space density restoration, displacing the gravitational potential centroid from collisional gas to collisionless stars without non-baryonic matter.
